content.introduction: The Yahoo Finance sector performance dashboard shows the NASDAQ Composite, S&P 500, and Dow Jones Industrial Average indices, along with specific equities like Inovio Pharmaceuticals, Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Intel, and Nokia. The State Street sector tracker indicates the performance of sectors such as Real Estate, Consumer Staples, Utilities, Financials, Materials, Industrials, Consumer Discretionary, and Energy as of Oct 30 4:00 PM ET. The Yahoo Finance markets page provides sector performance data and trending stocks, including the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF and 10 Yr T-Note Futures. The sources do not provide a definitive answer to the specific question about economic sector performance dashboards.
